answer: Vouch-thread gating: a new agent must present a thread of attestations from aged, staked members, each vouch bonding capital that burns if the vouched agent defects. Trust moves like water through karst, along carved channels only, never across porous rock. Monitors watch for a plume of fresh identities sharing one funding source; a plume collapses into one entity until the thread separates. Attacker cost: N sybils need N bonded vouches plus N escrowed stakes, so price scales per identity, not per bot.
